background: LBBW is the Landesbank of Baden-Wurttemberg, owned by the state, the regional savings banks and the city of Stuttgart, a corporate, real-estate and capital-markets lender that also runs retail banking through BW-Bank.
synthesis: Ratings are AA- from Fitch after the upgrade on 12 May 2026 and Aa2 from Moody's, both stable, resting on the savings-bank sector's protection scheme. Capital is mixed against EU and Nordic peers: CET1 of 16.6% is above the 16.4% median and has risen 1.9 points since 30 Jun 2024, while leverage of 4.5% is in the bottom quarter against 5.5%. Liquidity is on the weak side, with LCR of 135% and NSFR of 113% both in the bottom quarter, and NSFR down 7 points since 30 Jun 2025. The figures run to 31 Mar 2026. Nothing has been flagged in the last 90 days.
